=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:225-229 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The support-version grep can match the pre-existing Claude transfer guard rather than verifying that the OpenCode transfer guard is present.
  WHY: An older helper can pass the check and transfer read-mode OpenCode verdict edits into the host workspace, violating the isolation boundary.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20965-20996 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When an escalated issue's head changes but the `ai:needs-human` latch is not cleared, the handler deletes the isolation state and continues to run the judge.
  WHY: A human-applied or unsuccessfully verified latch remains on the issue but is ignored; the isolation record is lost and autonomous processing bypasses the human gate.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21395-21405 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The escalation state is marked `escalated=true` only when the escalation comment response yields a numeric comment ID.
  WHY: If the comment POST fails or its response cannot be parsed after the label is applied, the next poll does not recognize the escalation and retries the judge on the same head.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21368 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `sandbox_cleanup_failed_before_run` is accepted as an isolation reason even though no code path writes that value.
  WHY: The whitelist contains an unreachable reason label; unexpected values fall through to `unknown`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21375-21377 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The state update replaces the entire isolation entry for the issue, potentially discarding fields written by a concurrent update.
  WHY: If an escalation update lands between the count read and this write, `escalated`, `comment_id`, and `owned_label` can be lost.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:264-270, 722-728 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The poll workflow does not install OpenCode or warm its models.dev cache, although the fallback calls `write_opencode_config.sh`, which requires that cache.
  WHY: On a fresh runner, the config helper fails and the fallback defers the judge instead of evaluating the PR.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When Claude is not selected or not usable, run the judge with the codex engine inside the same credential-free review_untrusted_sandbox.sh" (PR auto-decision AD-1)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` has no `install-opencode` step and does not warm `~/.cache/opencode/models.json`; the existing Codex and Claude installation steps do not install OpenCode, so `write_opencode_config.sh` fails and the fallback cannot execute.
- requirement: “When Claude is not selected or not usable, run the judge with the codex engine inside the same credential-free `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`.”
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::_poller_rb_judge_sandbox_attempt` and the engine dispatch in `scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The poller passes `codex` as the engine, but the helper's non-Claude path invokes OpenCode (`scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:310-375`); there is no Codex CLI execution path in the sandbox helper.
- requirement: AD-2 — "Defer, then after a bounded number of consecutive isolation failures on the same PR head, label the issue `ai:needs-human`, post one comment naming the sandbox failure reason, and stop retrying until the head changes."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` head-change path (lines 20951-20996)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: When `RB_ISOLATION_ESCALATED=true` and a new head SHA arrives but `ai:needs-human` cannot be cleared, the code deletes `review_blocked_isolation_state` and proceeds to the judge.
- requirement: AD-2 — "post one comment naming the sandbox failure reason ... stop retrying until the head changes."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21395-21402`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `escalated=true` is set only when the comment ID is numeric; if the comment post fails after the label is applied, the next poll does not skip the judge on the same head.
- requirement: Review-blocked judge must run inside an equally isolated sandbox when `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh` predates the OpenCode access-guard change (per the LINKED ISSUE recommendation "retry the judge only in an equally isolated, credential-free environment or defer it automatically").
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:227` — the support-version grep guard.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The grep pattern matches the pre-existing Claude execution block at `scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:300`, so an older helper can pass the guard without the OpenCode transfer guard.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:225-229 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The support-version grep can match the Claude execution guard rather than verifying the OpenCode transfer guard.
  WHY: An older helper can pass the check and transfer read-mode OpenCode verdict output into the host workspace, violating the read-mode contract.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20961-20992 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: If an escalated issue's head changes while `owned_label` is false, the latch-clearing block is skipped, the isolation state is deleted, and the judge runs.
  WHY: The issue can still carry `ai:needs-human`, but the handler does not check for it before invoking the judge.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20969-20988 (latch-verification API calls) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Transient failures in the paginated comments or events calls can prevent latch verification, after which the handler deletes the isolation state and runs the judge.
  WHY: The latch remains while its tracking record is lost, so the judge runs against an uncleared human-gated issue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21395-21402 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The state is marked escalated only when the escalation comment response yields a numeric comment ID.
  WHY: If the label is applied but the response ID is missing or malformed, the judge and escalation comment are retried on later poll cycles.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (case statement listing `sandbox_cleanup_failed_before_run`) | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The reason whitelist accepts `sandbox_cleanup_failed_before_run`, but no code path writes that reason.
  WHY: The label is unreachable; unexpected values fall through to `unknown`.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (newly introduced `_poller_rb_judge_sandbox_attempt` codex path) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not install OpenCode or warm the models.dev cache required by `write_opencode_config.sh`.
  WHY: Every OpenCode sandbox attempt fails before the sandbox starts, so the judge defers until escalation.
- Requirement: "When Claude is not selected or not usable, run the judge with the codex engine inside the same credential-free `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`" (PR auto-decision AD-1)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  Evidence of absence: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` has no `uses: ./.github/actions/install-opencode` step and no `opencode models --refresh`. The existing `install-codex` and `install-claude` steps do not install OpenCode. Without this, the codex-engine sandbox path can never execute.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
